verdict.rationale: The Nix manual says Nix can automatically skip building from source and use a binary cache, a web server providing pre-built binaries. nix.dev advertises 'transparent build caching using binary caches', and nix-shell 'will build or download' dependencies. A community user confirms that artifacts built once on remote builders are shared across devs, CI and deployment, saving hours. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of configuring caches (substituters, signing/trust keys, the default public cache) and independent hands-on evidence of pulling public prebuilt packages specifically.
